jobs.title: Senior Associate Product Manager
jobs.description: Responsibilities Responsibilities The Senior Associate Product Manager is responsible for supporting Product Managers as part of a product management team; however, they are not the accountable Product Manager for a product. They develop knowledge, experience, and skills by working side-by-side with experienced product managers while contributing to the success of complex products and product families. The successful candidate will: Lead product discovery sessions, helping teams understand business problems, customer needs, and outcome hypotheses. Support cross-functional teams including Product, Engineering, Design, Data, and Business stakeholders in ideating and executing experiments. Gather, analyze, and communicate product insights, customer feedback, operational metrics, and measurable outcomes to stakeholders. Maintain and communicate product health and operational metrics, ensuring progress against product goals and objectives is visible and measurable. Collaborate with Product Managers and Agile teams to identify and resolve dependencies, impediments, and delivery risks. Act as or support the role of Product Owner by contributing to backlog management, story refinement, acceptance criteria definition, prioritization discussions, and sprint ceremonies. Communicate product releases, roadmap updates, experiment outcomes, and key product decisions to stakeholders and partners. Work closely with business leaders, finance partners, and stakeholders to support change readiness, product adoption, and business outcomes. Demonstrate strong communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills while building relationships across product disciplines. Leverage data, metrics, and analytical thinking to support data-driven decision-making and identify opportunities for product improvement. Continuously build expertise across all phases of the product lifecycle while contributing to an effective and mature product management practice. Qualifications Bachelor's Degree or equivalent. 6–10 years of overall professional experience. 3+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, Business Analysis, or a related discipline within a highly collaborative, fast-paced environment. Demonstrated experience with product lifecycle management and roadmap planning. Experience working with product, engineering, and business stakeholders. Experience managing multiple workloads and competing priorities. Strong stakeholder management, communication, facilitation, influencing, and negotiation skills. Demonstrated ability to leverage data and insights to drive business and product decisions. Preferred Qualifications Strong analytical and quantitative aptitude with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, derive insights, and support evidence-based decision-making. Excellent mathematical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills. Experience creating reports, dashboards, KPIs, and product health metrics. Experience driving prioritization discussions and balancing customer, business, and technical needs. Understanding of Cloud concepts. Working experience in Agile (Scrum/Kanban) environments. Hands-on experience with Jira, Confluence, and Miro. Exposure to end users, business stakeholders, and technology teams. Understanding of Distribution in Life/Group Insurance would be a plus. Key Skills Product Discovery & Experimentation Product Lifecycle Management Product Ownership Agile Delivery Stakeholder Management Data Analysis & Insights Quantitative Problem Solving Business Acumen Prioritization & Decision Making Communication & Facilitation Influencing & Negotiation Qualifications Qualifications Bachelor's Degree or equivalent. 6–10 years of overall professional experience. 3+ years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, Business Analysis, or a related discipline within a highly collaborative, fast-paced environment. jobs.title: Product Manager 2 (Hybrid Only)
jobs.description: What You'll Do We’re seeking a passionate and experienced Product Manager to join our Engineering Experience and Enablement team (EXE). EXE is dedicated to accelerating efficient software delivery at Principal by providing technology teams with a delightful experience in which to build. This product role is central to shaping and advancing our evolving product family as we expand to support an AI-native product delivery life cycle. The work includes enabling Product delivery teams and AI agents to invoke trusted, Principal-specific expertise inside the tools where work happens. It also means defining the experience, contribution model, quality bar, publishing path, and feedback signals that make our expertise discoverable, reliable, and valuable across the enterprise product delivery life cycle. You’ll have the opportunity to: Drive Discovery & Insights: Use experimentation, analytics, and user research to uncover opportunities and prioritize high-value initiatives. Own Product Strategy: Collaborate with technical and delivery leads to develop and evolve the product vision, strategy, and roadmap. Measure & Optimize: Track product performance, make data-driven decisions, and continuously evolve the product to meet enterprise needs. Engage & Influence: Partner with leaders across technology spaces as stakeholders, advocates, and users of EXE products to advance the EXE vision. Mentor & Shape Culture: Support and mentor other product managers, sharing best practices to foster a strong, high-performing product culture. We are looking for individuals who are excited to serve Principal’s technology teams and create an environment where teams can build great products for our customers—and enjoy their work doing it. If you’re passionate about people, technology, and the opportunity to make trusted expertise easier to find, apply, and improve through AI-enabled experiences, we’d love to have you join us Who You Are We are looking for someone with:  4+ years of business, technology, or product management experience; or equivalent demonstrated through the following: work experience, military experience, or education.  Demonstrated experience managing 1 or multiple products.  Demonstrated experience with strategic thinking, collaboration, and decision making in a product environment.  Demonstrated ability to successfully manage multiple workloads and/or competing priorities.  Demonstrated experience with stakeholders and relationship management in a product environment.  Demonstrated experience leading, influencing, and negotiating in a product environment.  Demonstrated experience leveraging diverse perspectives and use of customer, user, or partner data and insights to inform decisions and actions.  2+ years working in a highly collaborative, fast-paced environment with engineering teams and stakeholders. Additional Preferred experience: Comfortable getting up to speed on technical topics (with time and support to upskill)  Experience supporting an AI-native product delivery life cycle. Familiarity with GitHub, Cloud Solutions, and the Software Development Life Cycle    Salary Range Information Salary ranges below reflect targeted base salaries. Our Enterprise Data and Analytics organization provides data, insights, reports, and tools to teams and individuals throughout our business and analytics community. Needs range from understanding customer behavior to financial patterns to knowing better how we work. We dig in deeply with requests to address not just the ask, but the underlying needs for now and the future to come. jobs.title: Práctica Product Analyst
jobs.description: ¿Qué esperamos de ti? En AFP Cuprum somos más de 1.000 colaboradores comprometidos con un mejor futuro para nuestros afiliados. Contamos con 45 años administrando pensiones, y destacando en la entrega de la mejor experiencia y servicio. Invertimos para el futuro, con nuestros afiliados al centro de todo lo que hacemos. Estamos siempre creciendo y buscando nuevas oportunidades de aprendizaje. Formamos parte de Principal Financial Group, líder global con 145 años de trayectoria, presencia en 5 continentes y a nivel regional en Chile, México y Brasil. Te invitamos a ser parte de una empresa que trabaja cada día por mejorar el futuro financiero de las personas. Somos parte Principal Financial Group, líder global en inversiones y hoy estamos buscando a un Practicante Product Analyst quien tendrá la misión de trabajar en el descubrimiento, definición, construcción, implementación, mantención y eliminación de los productos digitales e iniciativas que son parte de la Estrategia Digital definida por la compañia, con el propósito de garantizar mejoras en la experiencia de nuestros clientes. ¿Qué esperamos de ti? Reunir y analizar necesidades, procesos y requerimientos, y documentarlos para ayudar en la definición y comunicación del producto a construir. Apoyar en la redacción y refinamiento de historias de usuario. Apoyar al equipo en la comunicación y/o reporte de avance de los distintos temas en que el equipo trabaja. Colaborar con la gestión del flujo de desarrollo de productos digitales, revisando métricas de valor, de equipo, de proceso y metodológicas. Colaborar en la certificación de la calidad de los productos que el equipo construye, mantiene y libera. Y apoya en el monitoreo, análisis y corrección de errores y/o comportamientos inesperados de los productos digitales a cargo del equipo. . ¿Qué buscamos? Profesionales de Ingeniería Comercial, Civil Industrial o afines que se encuentren en el último año de carrera o recién egresados. Manejo avanzado de Excel (excluyente). Deseable manejo en SQL e IA. Deseable conocimiento en herramientas de analítica y optimización web (Google Analytics, Jira, Confluence, etc.). Nuestra Cultura de Trabajo Somos conscientes que un adecuado equilibrio es la mejor forma de tener equipos exitosos y empoderados, por lo cual adoptamos un enfoque de flexibilidad que se adapta a tus necesidades y de tu equipo con base en una cultura de confianza. Nuestro compromiso es entregarte los recursos y oportunidades que necesitas para ser exitoso. ¿Qué podemos ofrecerte? Practica remunerada Oportunidades de aprendizaje y herramientas de capacitación ¡Flexibilidad! Modalidad de trabajo híbrida. Vamos solo 1 o 2 veces a la semana a la oficina. Más tiempo para ti: tenemos una jornada menor a la legal, de 39,5 hrs semanales. Los viernes trabajamos hasta las 14:00 hrs. Experiencia Principal En Principal, valoramos el balance tanto a nivel personal como profesional. Juntos, estamos imaginando un futuro orientado a darle propósito a los servicios financieros, y eso comienza contigo. Nuestro éxito depende de las experiencias y talentos únicos de nuestros colaboradores. Apoyándolos de la misma manera que a nuestros clientes: con ofertas de beneficios integrales y competitivas diseñadas para proteger su bienestar físico, financiero y social. Visite nuestro sitio de carreras para obtener más información sobre nuestro propósito, valores y beneficios. Empleador inclusivo Tenemos un compromiso con la igualdad de oportunidades, por lo que todos los solicitantes cualificados recibirán consideración para el empleo sin distinción de raza, color, religión, sexo, orientación sexual, identidad de género, origen nacional, o capacidades físicas.
